thm proposition_34:
    ? forall a, b, c, d cart(R, R):
        $f2::is_proper_parallelogram(a, b, c, d)
        =>:
            $m0::f0::are_segments_congruent(a, b, c, d)
            $m0::f0::are_segments_congruent(a, d, b, c)
            $m0::f0::are_angles_congruent(d, a, b, b, c, d)
            $m0::f0::are_angles_congruent(a, b, c, c, d, a)
            exist half R+ st {$f2::has_triangle_area(a, b, d, half), $f2::has_triangle_area(b, c, d, half), $f2::has_parallelogram_area(a, b, c, d, 2 * half)}
    thm local_parallelogram_coordinate_closure:
        ? forall par_a, par_b, par_c, par_d cart(R, R):
            $f2::is_proper_parallelogram(par_a, par_b, par_c, par_d)
            =>:
                par_d(1) = (par_a(1) + par_c(1)) - par_b(1)
                par_d(2) = (par_a(2) + par_c(2)) - par_b(2)
        thm local_independent_directions_force_zero_offset:
            ? forall u1, u2, v1, v2, k1, k2 R:
                u1 * v2 - u2 * v1 != 0
                u1 * k2 - u2 * k1 = 0
                v1 * k2 - v2 * k1 = 0
                =>:
                    k1 = 0
                    k2 = 0
            have determinant R = u1 * v2 - u2 * v1
            determinant != 0
            determinant * k1 = (u1 * v2 - u2 * v1) * k1 = v1 * (u1 * k2 - u2 * k1) - u1 * (v1 * k2 - v2 * k1) = v1 * 0 - u1 * 0 = 0
            determinant * k2 = (u1 * v2 - u2 * v1) * k2 = v2 * (u1 * k2 - u2 * k1) - u2 * (v1 * k2 - v2 * k1) = v2 * 0 - u2 * 0 = 0
            k1 = determinant * k1 / determinant = 0 / determinant = 0
            k2 = determinant * k2 / determinant = 0 / determinant = 0
        by def $f2::is_proper_parallelogram(par_a, par_b, par_c, par_d)
        by def $f1::are_parallel_lines(par_a, par_b, par_d, par_c)
        by def $f1::are_parallel_lines(par_a, par_d, par_b, par_c)
        by def $m0::f0::is_parallel(par_a, par_b, par_d, par_c)
        by def $m0::f0::is_parallel(par_a, par_d, par_b, par_c)
        have u1 R = par_b(1) - par_a(1)
        have u2 R = par_b(2) - par_a(2)
        have v1 R = par_d(1) - par_a(1)
        have v2 R = par_d(2) - par_a(2)
        have k1 R = ((par_a(1) + par_c(1)) - par_b(1)) - par_d(1)
        have k2 R = ((par_a(2) + par_c(2)) - par_b(2)) - par_d(2)
        release thm m0::f0::collinear_det_expand(par_a, par_b, par_d)
        u1 * v2 - u2 * v1 = (par_b(1) - par_a(1)) * (par_d(2) - par_a(2)) - (par_b(2) - par_a(2)) * (par_d(1) - par_a(1)) = m0::f0::det(m0::f0::vec(par_a, par_b), m0::f0::vec(par_a, par_d)) != 0
        release thm m0::f0::vec_coordinate_formula(par_a, par_b)
        release thm m0::f0::vec_coordinate_formula(par_a, par_d)
        release thm m0::f0::vec_coordinate_formula(par_d, par_c)
        release thm m0::f0::vec_coordinate_formula(par_b, par_c)
        release thm m0::f0::det_coordinate_formula(m0::f0::vec(par_a, par_b), m0::f0::vec(par_d, par_c))
        release thm m0::f0::det_coordinate_formula(m0::f0::vec(par_a, par_d), m0::f0::vec(par_b, par_c))
        m0::f0::det(m0::f0::vec(par_a, par_b), m0::f0::vec(par_d, par_c)) = (par_b(1) - par_a(1)) * (par_c(2) - par_d(2)) - (par_b(2) - par_a(2)) * (par_c(1) - par_d(1))
        (par_b(1) - par_a(1)) * (par_c(2) - par_d(2)) - (par_b(2) - par_a(2)) * (par_c(1) - par_d(1)) = m0::f0::det(m0::f0::vec(par_a, par_b), m0::f0::vec(par_d, par_c)) = 0
        m0::f0::det(m0::f0::vec(par_a, par_d), m0::f0::vec(par_b, par_c)) = (par_d(1) - par_a(1)) * (par_c(2) - par_b(2)) - (par_d(2) - par_a(2)) * (par_c(1) - par_b(1))
        (par_d(1) - par_a(1)) * (par_c(2) - par_b(2)) - (par_d(2) - par_a(2)) * (par_c(1) - par_b(1)) = m0::f0::det(m0::f0::vec(par_a, par_d), m0::f0::vec(par_b, par_c)) = 0
        u1 * k2 - u2 * k1 = (par_b(1) - par_a(1)) * (((par_a(2) + par_c(2)) - par_b(2)) - par_d(2)) - (par_b(2) - par_a(2)) * (((par_a(1) + par_c(1)) - par_b(1)) - par_d(1)) = (par_b(1) - par_a(1)) * (par_c(2) - par_d(2)) - (par_b(2) - par_a(2)) * (par_c(1) - par_d(1)) = m0::f0::det(m0::f0::vec(par_a, par_b), m0::f0::vec(par_d, par_c)) = 0
        v1 * k2 - v2 * k1 = (par_d(1) - par_a(1)) * (((par_a(2) + par_c(2)) - par_b(2)) - par_d(2)) - (par_d(2) - par_a(2)) * (((par_a(1) + par_c(1)) - par_b(1)) - par_d(1)) = (par_d(1) - par_a(1)) * (par_c(2) - par_b(2)) - (par_d(2) - par_a(2)) * (par_c(1) - par_b(1)) = m0::f0::det(m0::f0::vec(par_a, par_d), m0::f0::vec(par_b, par_c)) = 0
        release thm local_independent_directions_force_zero_offset(u1, u2, v1, v2, k1, k2)
        (par_a(1) + par_c(1)) - par_b(1) = ((par_a(1) + par_c(1)) - par_b(1)) - par_d(1) + par_d(1) = k1 + par_d(1) = 0 + par_d(1) = par_d(1)
        (par_a(2) + par_c(2)) - par_b(2) = ((par_a(2) + par_c(2)) - par_b(2)) - par_d(2) + par_d(2) = k2 + par_d(2) = 0 + par_d(2) = par_d(2)
    by def $f2::is_proper_parallelogram(a, b, c, d)
    by def $f1::are_parallel_lines(a, b, d, c)
    by def $f1::are_parallel_lines(a, d, b, c)
    release thm local_parallelogram_coordinate_closure(a, b, c, d)
    (a(1) + c(1)) - d(1) = (a(1) + c(1)) - ((a(1) + c(1)) - b(1)) = b(1)
    (a(2) + c(2)) - d(2) = (a(2) + c(2)) - ((a(2) + c(2)) - b(2)) = b(2)
    release thm m0::f0::parallelogram_sides(a, b, c, d)
    release thm m0::f0::parallelogram_sides(a, d, c, b)
    release thm m0::f0::distance_sq_symmetric(a, b)
    release thm m0::f0::distance_sq_symmetric(a, d)
    release thm m0::f0::distance_sq_symmetric(b, c)
    release thm m0::f0::distance_sq_symmetric(c, d)
    m0::f0::distance_sq(a, b) = m0::f0::distance_sq(d, c) = m0::f0::distance_sq(c, d)
    m0::f0::distance_sq(a, d) = m0::f0::distance_sq(b, c)
    by def $m0::f0::are_segments_congruent(a, b, c, d)
    by def $m0::f0::are_segments_congruent(a, d, b, c)
    d(1) - a(1) = ((a(1) + c(1)) - b(1)) - a(1) = c(1) - b(1)
    b(1) - c(1) = -(c(1) - b(1)) = -(d(1) - a(1))
    d(1) - c(1) = ((a(1) + c(1)) - b(1)) - c(1) = a(1) - b(1) = -(b(1) - a(1))
    c(1) - d(1) = -(d(1) - c(1)) = -(a(1) - b(1))

    d(2) - a(2) = ((a(2) + c(2)) - b(2)) - a(2) = c(2) - b(2)

    d(2) - c(2) = ((a(2) + c(2)) - b(2)) - c(2) = a(2) - b(2) = -(b(2) - a(2))
    c(2) - d(2) = -(d(2) - c(2)) = -(a(2) - b(2))

    release thm m0::f0::perpendicular_dot_expand(c, b, c, d)
    release thm m0::f0::perpendicular_dot_expand(a, d, a, b)
    m0::f0::dot(m0::f0::vec(c, b), m0::f0::vec(c, d)) = (b(1) - c(1)) * (d(1) - c(1)) + (b(2) - c(2)) * (d(2) - c(2)) = -(d(1) - a(1)) * -(b(1) - a(1)) + -(d(2) - a(2)) * -(b(2) - a(2)) = (d(1) - a(1)) * (b(1) - a(1)) + (d(2) - a(2)) * (b(2) - a(2)) = m0::f0::dot(m0::f0::vec(a, d), m0::f0::vec(a, b))
    m0::f0::distance_sq(a, d) = m0::f0::distance_sq(b, c) = m0::f0::distance_sq(c, b)

thm proposition_35:
    ? forall a, b, c, d, upper_start, f cart(R, R):
        $f2::is_proper_parallelogram(a, b, c, d)
        $f2::is_proper_parallelogram(upper_start, b, c, f)
        m0::f0::det(m0::f0::vec(b, c), m0::f0::vec(d, f)) = 0
        =>:
            exist total R+ st {$f2::has_parallelogram_area(a, b, c, d, total), $f2::has_parallelogram_area(upper_start, b, c, f, total)}
    release thm proposition_34(a, b, c, d)
    obtain first_half from exist half R+ st {$f2::has_triangle_area(a, b, d, half), $f2::has_triangle_area(b, c, d, half), $f2::has_parallelogram_area(a, b, c, d, 2 * half)}
    release thm proposition_34(upper_start, b, c, f)
    obtain second_half from exist half R+ st {$f2::has_triangle_area(upper_start, b, f, half), $f2::has_triangle_area(b, c, f, half), $f2::has_parallelogram_area(upper_start, b, c, f, 2 * half)}
    release thm m0::f0::vec_coordinate_formula(b, c)
    release thm m0::f0::vec_coordinate_formula(d, f)
    release thm m0::f0::det_coordinate_formula(m0::f0::vec(b, c), m0::f0::vec(d, f))
    (c(1) - b(1)) * (f(2) - d(2)) - (c(2) - b(2)) * (f(1) - d(1)) = m0::f0::det(m0::f0::vec(b, c), m0::f0::vec(d, f)) = 0
    release thm m0::f0::collinear_det_expand(b, c, d)
    release thm m0::f0::collinear_det_expand(b, c, f)
    m0::f0::det(m0::f0::vec(b, c), m0::f0::vec(b, f)) = (c(1) - b(1)) * (f(2) - b(2)) - (c(2) - b(2)) * (f(1) - b(1)) = (c(1) - b(1)) * (d(2) - b(2)) - (c(2) - b(2)) * (d(1) - b(1)) + ((c(1) - b(1)) * (f(2) - d(2)) - (c(2) - b(2)) * (f(1) - d(1))) = m0::f0::det(m0::f0::vec(b, c), m0::f0::vec(b, d)) + 0 = m0::f0::det(m0::f0::vec(b, c), m0::f0::vec(b, d))
    m0::f0::det(m0::f0::vec(b, c), m0::f0::vec(b, f)) ^ 2 = m0::f0::det(m0::f0::vec(b, c), m0::f0::vec(b, d)) ^ 2
    by def $f2::has_triangle_area(b, c, d, first_half)
    by def $f2::has_triangle_area(b, c, f, second_half)
    2 * first_half = sqrt (m0::f0::det(m0::f0::vec(b, c), m0::f0::vec(b, d)) ^ 2) = sqrt (m0::f0::det(m0::f0::vec(b, c), m0::f0::vec(b, f)) ^ 2) = 2 * second_half
    first_half = 2 * first_half / 2 = 2 * second_half / 2 = second_half
    witness exist total R+ st {$f2::has_parallelogram_area(a, b, c, d, total), $f2::has_parallelogram_area(upper_start, b, c, f, total)} from 2 * first_half
